After years of enslaving resistant pawns, willing followers spell good tidings indeed.

technology.short_description: To the most learned, Shyish may be wielded to even alter the very fabric of reality, bending the world to an Undead vision of glory.
Knowing death is the alternative, Sylvania’s skilled marksmen willingly pledge loyalty to the fell Lords of their own lands, rather than a far-off, absent Emperor.
With a surge of dark power, the slow, mindless servants of the Undead are driven to hasten the construction of their masters’ terrifying edifices.
It is no easy trick of necromancy to push the slow trudge of the rotting ranks into a rapid advance that can dive headlong into a target.
Given time, a more considered process of corpse-raising allows wards to be bound, making a Zombie more resilient than one raised in haste.
Pain, fear and exhaustion mean nothing to corpses raised to obey the command to endure and given the arcane means to do so.
Bounding across fields of the fallen, the flesh-eaters pounce upon foes with blood-curdling roars, pausing only to gorge on the dead beneath them.
Drawn from the most hardened ancient retinues, these heroes of war are as implacable and unyielding in death as they were in life.
Blood-gorged and saturated with their dark masters' sorceries, some beasts can shrug off wounds that should have slain them many times over.
Lycindia rules through punishment and fear, finding beauty only in the obedience brought with suffering.
Naaima smiles as empires tangle themselves in plots set in motion by her single whispered word.
Heterneb carries memories from the first nights of Lahmia, and in her presence younger immortals remember their place.
Bellatash moves like moonlight over marble – cold and flawless – with murder hidden behind every soft word.
Giselle's unnatural grace and hypnotic allure leave mortals spellbound long before they realise they stand before a monster.
The dead are not left to rot in neglect, but preserved, prepared and awakened when the coven has need of them.

items.colour_text: Shuffling around the old cemetery, keeping things in order, stumbling upon little tidbits the Master might fancy... oh, what's this, then?

effects.description: Improves the rarity of items gained from battle

technology.short_description: Reliable adjutants and conspirators are vital to the will of a Vampire Lord. As one awakens, their servants' devotion remains undimmed.
Cabals of powerful Necromancers shall bow before you, looking to further their endeavours and grow their already frightening power.

items.colour_text: Warlocks are those that practise the dark arts away from the overseers in the Colleges of Magic. They are the prey of Witch Hunters and more…

effects.description: Winds of Magic power reserve capacity: +3

technology.short_description: Nothing has the power to wrestle a Master Necromancer's army from his clutches!
It is certain that millennia of dark deeds awaits those who truly master understanding of Shyish and the bonds of mortal shells.
A Necromancer's desperate thirst for knowledge oft leads them right into the clutches of the most powerful Undead.
The pits are filled with flesh for the legions. In our trudge to dominance, the lands will drown in a stampede of the dead.

items.colour_text: This one washed ashore as a mere corpse, until he was put to work.

technology.short_description: Favouring the Zombies with more bulk to them means a host that absorbs more punishment, afforded by the rot of their remaining flesh.
As blood touches the slavering lips of these wretched creatures, they grow ravenous and hollow-eyed, strengthening with each bite.
Forged for kings and buried with champions, the Grave Guards' ancient armaments still carry the gravitas of the long-dead who once wielded them.
Howls, screeches, and glowing eyes flit from the gloom of accursed places, where the clawed, the fanged, and the hook-winged thrive.
From the courts of Malstonia comes Lycindia, a Handmaiden whose elegance conceals a taste for exquisite cruelty.
From distant Cathay comes Naaima, trained in patient schemes, veiled influence, and the quiet art of turning rivals upon themselves.
Heterneb is a relic of the first courts, her counsel sharpened by centuries of blood, betrayal and survival.
Raised amidst the intrigue and blood-soaked courts of Tilea, Bellatash is as deadly with promises as with concealed blades.
Giselle brings the refinement of Marienburg's high courts into the Coven, where charm is merely another kind of sharpened blade.

Over countless centuries, the wealthy predecessors of the Vampire Bloodlines amassed vast estates, their hoards buried with them in their ornate tombs. Yet one need not annex whole cities to find them…
Dust-choked vaults are broken open, revealing blood-stained relics and old treasures buried with their unworthy owners.
The ancient bloodlines leave more than mere memories behind, and by your command, a scion of a storied lineage shall reveal their worth.
Only one bloodline is destined to rule! And yours has proven to be the most powerful.
With necromantic power such as this, even the world's foremost conjurers and champions of the dead deem it unwise not to serve.

items.colour_text: Bearing vessels of tainted blood, the Blood Seneschal sustains the Undead far from lands steeped in darkness.

technology.short_description: In time, the Skeleton ranks harden – bone and rust alike – as they advance with the patience of a tomb.
Corpse-raising offers a great destiny to the Necromancer, and an even greater one to the corpse, which would otherwise merely rot in the earth.
The longer ancient bones remain under a puppet master’s control, the easier they are to drive relentlessly and uncaringly towards their callous ends.
Beware a tomb lid ajar or an unhinged mausoleum door, accompanied by the cracking of bones in the darkness…
Iron wills and ancient oaths once spurred on those now made up of little more than reanimated bone, rusty armour, and jagged blades.
The more haunted the world becomes, the better habitat it is for the fell things that wish to drive the terrified into the darkness.
The Handmaidens are schooled in discretion, misdirection and the delicate work of silencing those who have seen too much.
The ranks of both Vampire and Undead will stretch to the ends of the earth. Behind these banners, the world of the living shall fall
Why bind oneself to the services of the powerful, when countless souls of witless bodies can be summoned without threat of your demise?
A modicum of armour and protection is crudely grafted onto the host's Corpse Carts, improving their survivability.
The fell visage of the deathly guards who protect the gathering of corpses gives pause to any who would dare oppose such desecration.
Across hidden crypts and plundered kingdoms, the aristocracy of the Undead gathers treasures hoarded since time immemorial.
Only one bloodline is destined to rule! And yours has proven to be the most powerful.
By fully embracing the Thirst, a Vampire's taste for blood drawn in battle can send them into the throes of bloodlust and otherworldly zeal.
Simply by tapping into their "gift" of the Thirst, Vampires may afford themselves much greater speed and vitality than the vast majority of mortals.
To call forth one of the greatest Vampire warriors, the Grand Master of the Blood Dragons himself, is to bring the darkest of days to our enemies
A dead mind is an empty vessel, free of trivial whims and questions. A fitting tool to achieve one's goals.

items.colour_text: This thing has no mind, it is a fleshy contraption powered by its master's will, used for mundane tasks and guarding the castle during daylight.

technology.short_description: There are few more macabre and dreaded sights than the endless legions of the Undead serving and operating under the command of one.
"Those who dare resist my rule will receive guests from beyond the grave."
Long has the Doom Lord waited to enact his revenge – Dieter Helsnicht may yet bring doom to the lands of Middenheim, and the world.
Imentet stands as the first chosen Handmaiden, setting the standard by which all others in the Coven shall be judged.
Elevated above her sisters, Imentet commands the Handmaidens with the poise of a queen and the patience of a spider.

To stand at Neferata's side is an honour that few survive, yet Imentet has done more than just endure – she has become the Blood Queen's most trusted confidante; a paragon of elegance, cunning, and absolute obedience.
Rumours swirl of a Vampire from the East, from the lands of Kislev, who carries Lahmian blood.
Death will always crawl back to its master for more.
Every barrow, graveyard and mausoleum is a silent kingdom of bones, devoted to bringing macabre strength to the dread manses of the Vampires.
Dark towers glow with ominous light, as thick shadows pool in the alleys of Undead-ridden cities. All that awaits the living who go there is death.
When one wields the power of death, one can loan and retract it at will!
Petty Unliving princes and dreadful Lords of Death alike shall bow before you. All Vampires must unite in singular purpose, or be cast aside.
Only one bloodline is destined to rule! And yours has proven to be the most powerful.
Ancient kings and queens of old serve with fierce countenance, ever wrathful of those who still cling to the warmth of life.
Where foul amalgams can be resewn and restitched, risen again as things only the darkest hearts can muster.
"I still see it, in the cold reaches of the night. It haunts my dreams. Pure hate with blackened talons, beckoning me to my doom."

"Bound in Blood. Forged in Battle. Focussed in Mind."
	– Tenets of the Blood Knights
Enchanted greatswords and Grail Knight lances alike have tried to gouge these toughened hides. All who held them met with evisceration.
Dark sigils carved onto the bones and flesh of bound creatures provide them with protective resilience anchored by Dark Magic and Necromantic rites.
Macabre energies constantly emanate from these foul carriages, invigorating their processions and making them tougher to attack directly.
Lahmians survive better together, for they can lend credence to each other's lies.
The heightened senses of the most battle-focused Vampires allow them to smell blood and feel vibrations of beating hearts from hundreds of feet away.
Only one bloodline is destined to rule! And yours has proven to be the most powerful.
Existing in a state between life and death, a Vampire weathered by war is more readily steeled against the natural world’s scourges and dangers.
By rekindling old allegiances, tracking down faded bloodlines, and calling upon forgotten obligations, those in positions of power and influence can be more easily turned.

items.colour_text: There are foolish mortals - usually rich, noble, dilettante types - who crave immortality and will be a Vampire's willing spy for the chance of damnation.

effects.description: Magic item drop chance from battle: +4%

technology.short_description: A Bretonnian hero turned tyrant, ever thirsting for blood and cruelty, the Red Duke shall pledge himself to the greater cause of vampiric glory.
The city of the master shall be served, its ever-multiplying Undead servants shambling in shadow, awaiting the call of their Necromancer keepers.
An eerie twilight lingers over the land. The warmth of the daylight sun feels somehow lesser, the nights darker and filled with terrors.
When countless riven souls of the dead can be molded to one's will with such ease, even Undead Champions take heed.
A powerful life force makes for hardy Undead warriors, many of whom can regenerate their form and strength with little assistance.
The black soul of some creatures hungers for the crimson wine of blood. It is an all-consuming thirst, never to be satiated.
Many tomb-risen wraiths and cairns of the earth still clasp ensorcelled blades of ancient provenance, eager to let them bite flesh once more.
The Undead riders wield their lances with a finesse and technique akin to the skilled horsemen they once were in life.
Of all the devolved, twisted creatures born of excess gore-feasting, few can withstand the fury of those unchained for war.
Call down the taloned monstrosities, let their deathly stink linger long after their talons have sundered armour, flesh and resolve.
Through dark rituals empowered by the Winds of Death, eerie parades of lost spirits resist all but the strongest weaponry brought to bear against them.
While a Handmaiden's flawless composure would have you believe otherwise, they are eager to sate their hunger.
As the Covens spread, hidden chambers are prepared to house the training of Handmaidens in every lair of influence.
The sweet release of death does not grant freedom from suffering, when the endless torment of servitude under a Lord of the Undead awaits.

items.colour_text: The lad appears a bit daft and can't tell the difference between a corpse and a cadaver, but his mere presence makes the Winds of Magic frustratingly fickle. For the enemies, at least.

technology.short_description: Necromantic scrying and rituals help return Vampires and other creatures to full strength if the safety of their own crypts is not a viable option.
Through ancient ritual, the vampiric empower themselves for battle, also bolstering the magic that binds spirit creatures to the world for longer periods.
Stirred to war are lambent, spectral horrors without form, almost impossible to touch, let alone harm.
"Give me at least dozen Knights, fully armed and hungry for battle. Be they alive or dead, the deed shall be done."
There are some beasts, as swift as they are savage, that even Undead Lords of great age come to fear, if not seek to control.
Any modicum of control over the monsters that hunt beneath the moon requires one to endure its death-heralding, ear-bursting shriek.
Decorations and effigies of bones, wings and skulls adorn the infernal carriages' flanks, distracting from iron-forged plating beneath.
The combination of a Lahmian's unnatural speed and flawless footwork make for unrivalled evasion.
Many Handmaidens are assigned their own personal horse-drawn carriages, allowing them to move with real haste and privacy.
Core to the establishment of every Coven is an escape plan for any unforeseen mishap.
Nobles seduced in advance of our Coven's establishment will provide access to their prime real estate.
A Handmaiden need not fear the dagger in the back.
Famed Vampires, young and old, rise to join the ranks, bringing a wealth of experience to help conquer the lands of the living in your name.

items.colour_text: Many Vampire Lords keep a mortal manservant around. After all, someone needs to dust the drapes.

technology.short_description: The Vampire Wars ended many hundreds of years in the past, but the experience and knowledge of those who survived it lives on as a boon to Vampire-kind.

items.colour_text: A source of sweet damnation, but more importantly, endless fact and rumour - all weapons to be used irrespective of their truth or relevance.

technology.short_description: An affinity for the magic of their sires runs strong in some Vampires. Years of legacies builds terrifying mastery, wielded in whispers of forbidden power.
Only one bloodline is destined to rule! And yours has proven to be the most powerful.
Prince or pauper, old or young. Their prior lives matter not – all the dead will serve.

items.colour_text: "Pass me ma spade, I'm lookin' for gallows bait!

technology.short_description: A concentrated effort ensures no corpse or body part is left untaken, each refashioned, reanimated, and reused.

items.colour_text: Corpses not interned in Morr's gardens straight away often find themselves on the black market.

technology.short_description: To raise a zombie or skeleton is child’s play – true martial mastery of the spirit world requires more of one’s soul.
It is the natural order of things that the bloodthirsty nature of war endlessly swells the ranks of the Undead.
Where the Winds of Shyish blow strongest, the bodies of the Undead ranks are replaced the easiest.
We must be careful to avoid the ire of the highest in society – unless they join the Sisterhood too, of course.
The Winds blow where death is prevalent, lingering in the lands where decay and brooding dead things lurk.
Illusion, darkness and silhouettes become weapons in the hands of those who thrive behind veils and daggers.

"Beware all ye who open this accursed tome, lest you lose your soul to the dark knowledge within."
	- Imperial Warning Seal, Book of Von Carstein Vol I
